items: 4 cups (32 oz) chicken stock, or enough to just cover the vegetables

steps.title: Chop the vegetables
steps.body: Chop into chunks and toss in a pot: **1 medium-large butternut squash** (peeled and de-seeded), **1–2 large carrots**, **1–3 stalks of celery**, **1–3 medium potatoes** and **1 medium onion**.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.body: Add **2 Tbsp butter** and sauté for 5 minutes on medium heat.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add **4 cups (32 oz) chicken stock**, or enough to just cover the vegetables, and simmer for 40 minutes or until vegetables are soft.

steps.title: Blend
steps.body: Take off the heat and blend until smooth with an immersion blender (or a regular blender).

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Add to taste: **½ cup heavy whipping cream**, salt and pepper.
